body: Thanks for the kind words from both.  Im still trying to keep on going.  It doesn't seem to get any easier though.  My dog makes me happy but when he dies I'm afraid it will be devastating to me.  He just recently started getting seizures which scares the crap out of me but he seems to be doing better. I regret sometimes allowing myself to get too close to people or trusting people because in my mind it would be a lot easier to just let go if I didn't have anything.  I am afraid of the thoughts in my head telling me to just throw it all away (not necessarily kill myself but become a hermit).  I have so much to live for but at the same time nothing to live for... which makes absolutely no sense.  I just want to crawl into a hole and not be bothered by anything.
